notes.title: Twogether: Project Indigos is an adventure that will not leave you indifferent!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129550/0b4902aaa6672d4e2339b67ed85346917bfe5b42.png

Twogether: Project Indigos is an adventure that will not leave you indifferent!

Twogether: Project Indigos is a title loaded with puzzles, supernatural powers and a beautiful story of friendship that aims to leave no one indifferent with a clear objective for our two protagonists: escape from the impregnable laboratory of Hexacells.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129550/eaf83180bf33d033f5e073c809843dde852cc1c0.jpg
Rafi and Sam are the two protagonists of this single-player third-person adventurer in what can be considered as a real Scape Room, in which the collaboration between both characters will be the key to success. However, they will not only count on each other's help but also on their incredible abilities and powers. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43129550/bb925a6f6f16d441a32484eed1ed5e8d1c521b1c.jpg
Think, examine, evaluate and act consistently keeping in mind all the elements of the environment if you wantyour decisions to succeed in overthrowing this real fortress. A sequence of original puzzles and riddles that make Hexacells a unique and mysterious place. 

Featured content:

 Setting: Discover Hexacells, a laboratory that clandestinely researches with children with supernatural powers. 
 Puzzles: face intricate puzzles in which it will be key to combine both powers. 
 Powers: teleport to unreachable places as Sam and move objects at a distance with Rafi's telekinesis. 
 Friendship: live together with Rafi and Sam the adventure in which they will discover friendship for the first time while escaping from Hexacells. 
 Now available on PS4 and Steam
